reason: Retrospective cohort of hypomethylating-agent treatment in relapsed/refractory AML reporting only response and survival, with no epigenetic marker measured in the patients.
Quantitative pyrosequencing of EPB41L3 and HPV DNA methylation in dissected cervical lesion tissue from 127 women, compared across CIN grades to inform precancer diagnosis and progression models.
Multi-institutional cohort of 159 glioblastoma patients in which MGMT promoter methylation status was an independent predictor of overall survival within prognostic models.
Genome-wide cord-blood DNA methylation measured in newborns of the ROLO randomised controlled trial of a low glycaemic index dietary intervention in pregnancy.
Longitudinal genome-wide DNA methylation profiling of 200 tumours from 77 glioma patients to derive predictive biomarkers of malignant recurrence.

IGFBP7 methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in primary gastric cancer patients alongside a multivariable prognostic analysis, though the human methylation comparison and its link to the prognostic outcome are only loosely described.
Case-control comparison of FREE2 intragenic DNA methylation in buccal epithelial cells of 25 boys with fragile X versus 19 controls, related to intellectual functioning as a biomarker.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation in 1017 LifeLines cohort participants related to long-term NO2 and particulate air pollution exposure.

Cell-biology study of tumour spheres in patient specimens describes the colorectal cancers as hypermethylated without stating that methylation was measured here or what analytic design the human specimen series followed.

DNA methylation as well as microRNAs was determined in lung tumour specimens of 40 patients grouped by presence or absence of COPD, linking the markers to underlying respiratory disease and therapeutic response.
EZH2 was assayed as nuclear protein expression by immunohistochemistry on tissue microarrays, which measures a methyltransferase's abundance rather than any histone mark or chromatin state.
Retrospective case series of 8 patients with CD8-positive cutaneous lymphoma and no comparison group.
Autoantibody repertoire profiling and network analysis in multiple sclerosis patients measured peptide reactivity and protein interactions, not any DNA methylation, histone or chromatin marker.

Two-step epigenetic Mendelian randomisation measuring DNA methylation and inflammatory markers in 822 individual GENOA participants, linking smoking to methylation, so it is individual-level rather than summary-statistics-only.
Nested case-control within EPIC-Italy measuring whole-genome blood DNA methylation in relation to air pollution exposure and later cardio-/cerebrovascular disease risk.

Development and validation of a minimal methylation classifier evaluated on human medulloblastoma samples from a completed clinical trial, yielding diagnostic subgroup assignment and survival differences, so tool development sits on an eligible diagnostic/prognostic design.
Nested case-control of 237 hepatocellular carcinoma cases and 257 controls measuring plasma DNA methylation of six genes to improve population risk prediction.

Buccal micronuclei and nuclear anomalies scored by Giemsa measure genome instability and nuclear morphology, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, the same logic the instrument applies to chromatin integrity tests.

Prognostic cohort of 809 colorectal cancer patients in which LINE-1 methylation and CpG island methylator phenotype were measured in tumours and entered the multivariable mortality model, although only as covariates to a protein-expression exposure.

Retrospective study of high-grade glioma patients relating tumour topography and age to measured MGMT promoter methylation, a marker used for prognosis and treatment selection, though no patient outcome was analysed here.
Tumour sequencing in a precision oncology cohort measured mutations and amplifications, including in chromatin-remodelling genes, but no DNA methylation, histone or chromatin-state marker.
Single-patient case report of an adult low-grade tumour transitioning to AT/RT over 14 years, despite the 450k methylation profiling performed.
EpiScore quantification of GSTP1, RASSF1 and APC methylation in prostate biopsy tissue from 102 prospectively enrolled men to stratify high-grade cancer risk at diagnosis.

Histone methylation marks H3K4me3, H3K9me2 and H3K9me3 assayed in left ventricular tissue from 14 dilated cardiomyopathy patients before and after LVAD support with normal ventricle controls, a non-randomised intervention comparison.
Glioma molecular subsets were defined by TERT promoter and IDH mutations with Ki-67 and 1p/19q status; no epigenetic marker was measured.

Promoter DNA methylation of the miR-34a and miR-34b/c loci was measured by MS-HRM in 51 lung adenocarcinomas and adjacent normal lung, so an eligible DNA methylation marker, not only ncRNA expression, was assayed in humans and related to metastasis.

In the human thymic epithelial tumour and normal tissue series the only epigenetic marker is miR-145-5p expression; the histone deacetylase inhibitor work establishing epigenetic regulation was done solely in a cell line.

GNAS methylation abnormalities were measured in children with early-onset obesity, including a cross-sectional screen of 24 unselected obese patients yielding a diagnostic finding, though the report is framed largely as a case series.
450K epigenome-wide association of DNA methylation with one-year average PM2.5 elemental species in a longitudinal cohort of 646 subjects.
Integrated analysis combining DNA methylation with sequencing in individual-level TNBC tumours from MDACC and TCGA/METABRIC cohorts to define subtypes predicting chemosensitivity and survival.
Circulating nucleosomes and histone-MPO complexes assayed in plasma of myeloproliferative neoplasm patients are circulating protein/DNA biomarkers rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Deep sequencing of lung neuroendocrine tumours measured mutations and copy number alterations in chromatin-remodelling genes, not any epigenetic mark.
EZH2 was measured as immunohistochemical protein expression in 33 primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphomas, which is enzyme abundance rather than a histone modification or chromatin state.
Cluster-of-clusters subtyping of 1023 TCGA non-small-cell lung cancers using individual-level DNA methylation among other platforms, with prognostic and therapeutic implications.

RND1 expression is said to be affected by promoter methylation across three human cohorts, but the abstract never states that methylation was assayed or in what material, and the described methods cover only expression, GSEA and siRNA knockdown.
Bisulphite pyrosequencing of ARNTL methylation in blood from 151 bipolar disorder patients versus 66 controls, a case-control comparison bearing on diagnosis.
Methylation panel of host and HPV genes measured in cervical cytology and urine cell-free DNA from two clinical cohorts to triage women for colposcopy and biopsy.
Claims-database analysis of guideline adherence for tympanostomy tube insertion measured no epigenetic marker of any kind.
Prognostic analysis of germline SNPs in PIWI-piRNA pathway genes measured genotypes and mRNA expression, not DNA methylation, histone marks or piRNAs themselves.
The only epigenetic-type readout, histone H2AX phosphorylation, was assayed in transfected HeLa cells rather than in the 192 primary ovarian insufficiency patients, whose data are sequence variants.
Birth cohort relating maternal toenail cadmium to placental PCDHAC1 promoter DNA methylation and fetal growth, a modifiable environmental exposure.
Genome-wide 450K methylation of visceral adipose tissue compared between insulin-resistant and insulin-sensitive morbidly obese patients with an independent validation set.
MMR and MGMT gene methylation measured in 62 serrated polyposis lesions from patients grouped by family history, defining molecular entities relevant to colorectal cancer risk.
Whole-blood 450K DNA methylation measured before and 160 minutes after a standardised meal in 26 healthy men, a modifiable dietary exposure.

In the human BRCA-related and sporadic breast cancer cohorts only microRNA expression was profiled; the chromatin remodeller SMARCA5 was assessed as transcript and protein in cell lines, not as a chromatin-state measurement.
PAX1 and ZNF582 methylation measured by quantitative methylation-specific PCR in 449 women referred for colposcopy to build diagnostic triage algorithms for cervical cancer.
The biosensor microarray measured serum autoantibody reactivity against modified histone H2B peptides, which is an antibody assay rather than a histone modification measured on patient chromatin.

DNA methylation of TGF-beta pathway gene regions including BAMBI was measured in human NSCLC tissues compared with tumour-free lung, though the study is largely mechanistic and the clinical decision link rests on diagnosis and therapeutic targeting.
Global genomic DNA methylation content measured in the pSoBid cohort of 666 subjects and related to dietary phosphate intake, red meat consumption and socioeconomic status.
Single-arm phase 2 trial of high-dose lenalidomide in hypomethylating-agent-refractory MDS reporting marrow response only, with no epigenetic marker measured.
